question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
-- Full result set
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS pts
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS pts
    FROM Match m
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        CAST(SUM(pts) AS INTEGER) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id, country_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rk
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT 
    r.season,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    r.total_points
FROM ranked r
JOIN League l ON r.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON r.country_id = c.id
JOIN Team t ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE r.rk = 1
ORDER BY r.season, l.name
